chapters.title: Where Homestead Valley Sits
chapters.description: Homestead Valley is an unincorporated community of roughly 900 homes in Southern Marin County, tucked into wooded canyons between Mill Valley and Mount Tamalpais State Park. The dark dashed line on the map is a placeholder standing in for the real Marin County CSA 14 service-area boundary — the official footprint of the community that this entire StoryMap is built around.

image.alt: View toward Mount Tamalpais from within Homestead Valley
image.caption: Looking toward Mount Tamalpais from within Homestead Valley.

chapters.title: Zooming Into the CSA 14 Boundary
chapters.description: This is Marin County Service Area 14 — Homestead Valley's official boundary, covering about 469 acres. It's the same line the County and local fire agencies use to define the community. The shape shown here is a placeholder; it will be swapped for the real boundary converted from the County's own GIS data.

image.alt: Marin County's official reference map of the CSA 14 boundary
image.caption: The County's official CSA 14 reference map — soon to be a live, zoomable layer above.
